# E04 calibration (rule §11.8)

Agreed by Matty and Ved in [#22](https://github.com/ReymoT/data-center-agentic/issues/22) on October 30, 2026: before any held-out output is opened, both raters extract assertions from two or three new practice outputs and compare **extraction only**.

**Files** (generated by `scripts/build_e04_calibration.py`; don't edit them by hand):

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `CALIBRATION_PACKET.md` | What raters read: one decision (CAL01) with two outputs, X and Y |
| `annotation_template.json` | Each rater's starting file |
| `calibration_cases.json` | The case data used by the validator and the comparison |

The practice outputs are hand-written on the hand-example fixture, not model outputs. They are neither development nor held-out cases and never enter either evaluation set. Calibration doesn't open any held-out output or freeze the evaluation sample.

## Steps

1. Each rater copies `annotation_template.json`, sets `rater`, and extracts independently from both outputs following section 11 of the [extraction rule](../EXTRACTION_RULE.md):
   - summary and limitation assertions as S1, S2… and L1, L2…;
   - raw-text assertions from a malformed output as R1, R2…;
   - an optional `reference_kind` on numeric assertions.

   Don't discuss the outputs or open the generator script before both files are saved.
2. Each rater keeps their file unchanged after saving it.
3. Compare, after agreeing on which S/L/R assertions describe the same fact:

   ```powershell
   .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/compare_e05_ratings.py --cases docs/e04/calibration/calibration_cases.json --a A.json --b B.json --matches MATCHES.json --out-dir OUT
   ```

4. Only extraction is compared: summary/limitation extraction agreement, the `raw_text` extraction section and `reference_kind` agreement. Any disagreement is resolved by **changing the rule text**, never by changing a development original.
